fusions.name: Cracked Sash
fusions.desc: Snaps a sash at a target up to 4 tiles away that deals 4 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at full reach.

fusions.name: Trailing Ribbons
fusions.desc: A lash around you that deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaves them [Stunned] for 0.8 seconds. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have travelled since you last used it, up to 30%.

fusions.name: Empty Cloak
fusions.desc: Increases your dodge chance by 25% for 9 seconds, and you finish it 2 tiles from where you stood.

fusions.name: Shuttle's Pace
fusions.desc: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 10%.
